title: Jake Steves and the Maccabees band, and Picou
summary: Jake Steves's white Maccabees band, which gave him the carnival parade work, and Picou playing with him.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: You were talking Sunday about the band he played in. Was it something like Squires? The carnival band.
Jake Steves. The Maccabees. The Maccabees.
I hadn't heard of that band. I just wondered if you knew any more about them. If any- You know- If-
That was his last name. Steve.
Jake Steves. That was his last name. Well, he's dead.
Jake was his first. Jake Steves. Jake and then Steve.
Steve. And the name of the band was the Maccabees band. Maccabees. I don't know of any of his people. That was a white band. Yes. Yes.
I hadn't heard of it, so I just wondered. You don't know any more about him? If he's still living as a man, Steve, or anybody?
Jake is dead, but he must have some people living. He had a lot of children. And you know who's another good musician, too? Silence. Climate Fair, Piku. All the Pikus.
Yes. We were just talking about him.

They used to play together. In those parades. Yeah, those parades. Well, I think that's how Papa played all the carnival parades, was through Jake Steve. No, I mean Piku used to play. Oh, yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah, it was Jake Steve, the one who had the contract. And he would be, you know, the leading. Oh, he always played the first horn. The first. Carnet, whatever. In those days they called it the carnet.
